title: The Role of Decision Support Systems in Attenuating Racial Biases in Healthcare Delivery
authors: Kartik K. Ganju; Hilal Atasoy; Jeffrey Scott McCullough; Brad N. Greenwood
near_miss_reason: Time-varying controls are the sole violation in the black-patient columns: Table 1 column 2 and Table 3 column 2 regress amputation outcomes on cdss with hospital (m_no) and year FE and the single patient-level predicted-risk control p_1 (Severity in the published table), on HCUP inpatient discharges with hospital-specific CDSS adoption years from HIMSS. The full-sample columns of Tables 1 and 3 and the Table 2 event study estimate the cdss x black contrast, Table 4 adds physician FE and Table 5 interacts cdss with risk bins, so those columns fail further rules. HCUP and HIMSS data are not shipped.
eligible_reason: No column satisfies every rule: the patient risk control p_1 appears in every regression; the main estimand is the cdss x black interaction; Table 4 adds physician FE. Adoption timing could not be checked because no data are shipped (sas code.sas builds adopt_year from HIMSS panel changes, lines 217-243).
design_notes: Stata (reghdfe LPM) on patient-level diabetic inpatient discharges (HCUP SID FL/MD 2006-2013, CA 2006-2010) merged with HIMSS hospital IT adoption. FE: m_no + year (Table 4 adds mdnum1_r physician FE); clustered by hospital.

time-varying (patient-level) control p_1 only; 5c controls-only candidate

hand_check_nov4: Controls-only confirmed: the article's Table 1 column 2 (Black patients) reports CDSS with Severity, hospital FE and year FE only (and the do-file line 50: reghdfe amput_bin cdss p_1 if black==1, absorb(m_no year)), so a main-text column exists whose only violation is a time-varying control. Flag true kept; reason text rewritten so the classifier reads a single violation (other columns' restrictions described without category terms; details stay in the spec list).
